localEquivalentBeforeStaging.providerRegistry: qwen-cloud (alias qwc), qwen-cloud-token-plan (alias qct) and bailian-coding-plan (alias bcp) exist as API-key chat providers only: serviceKinds ["llm"] or none, no video models, no videoConfig
localEquivalentBeforeStaging.videoGenerationAdapter: none for any of the three ids or aliases; open-sse/handlers/videoProviders/alibaba.js serves only the `alibaba`/`ali` identity on its own two origins
localEquivalentBeforeStaging.equivalenceNote: same DashScope video-synthesis wire contract as the integrated alibaba client, but that client accepts only the two alibaba origins and records usage under alibaba, so these identities need their own fixed hosts and attribution

exports.qwenCloudVideoAdapter: default adapter for qwen-cloud (VIDEO_GENERATION_ADAPTERS contract, responseFormats [url])
exports.createDashscopeVariantVideoAdapter: factory (providerId, { timeoutMs, submitTimeoutMs, requestTimeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, wait, now, regional })
exports.buildDashscopeVariantVideoRequest: (providerId, model, body) -> { model, input, parameters }; throws status 400
exports.isDashscopeVariantVideoModel: (providerId, model) -> boolean, that identity's source list only
exports.runDashscopeVariantVideoJob: submit + bounded poll; { success, url, taskId, accounting } or error result with acceptedJob
exports.dashscopeVariantAcceptedJob: (providerId, jobState) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.DASHSCOPE_VIDEO_IDENTITIES: frozen source registry entries per canonical id
exports.dashscopeRegionalVideoAdapters: region-parity instances keyed by canonical id (createDashscopeVariantVideoAdapter(id, { regional: true })); the instances registration wires
exports.dashscopeVideoEndpoint: (providerId, region) -> { origin, baseUrl, statusUrl } or null
exports.resolveDashscopeVideoPolling: (body, defaults) -> { timeoutMs, pollIntervalMs }; caller timeout_ms / poll_interval_ms within the source ceilings, throws status 400 for unusable values

notCovered: custom connection base URLs (refused before submit; a saved source preset counts as unset on the regional instances)
poll_timeout_ms (refused: the source DashScope handler reads timeout_ms)
DashScope image multimodal-generation and SpeechSynthesizer audio: see native-dashscope-image and native-dashscope-tts

add each identity's video models above with kind "video" and add "video" to serviceKinds; keep transports, aliases and chat models
list /v1/video/generations for the three identities after registration

polling.timeout_ms: whole ms >= 1 (number or digit string), capped at 600000; total job deadline including submit
polling.poll_interval_ms: whole ms >= 1, raised to 1000 and capped at 120000
refusedBeforeSubmit: an interval not shorter than the timeout
polling.accounting: regional success accounting.meta records pollTimeoutMs and pollIntervalMs

regionParity.map: open-sse/services/providerParity/native-dashscope-image/regions.js DASHSCOPE_MEDIA_ORIGINS: finite (identity, region) -> literal origin, ported from alibabaProviderRegions.ts media roots
regionParity.default: global-sg when providerSpecificData.region is unset or blank (source getDefaultAlibabaProviderRegion)
regionParity.spellings: global-sg: global, international, singapore, ap-southeast-1; china-beijing: china, cn, beijing, cn-beijing (case-insensitive, trimmed)
refusedBeforeSend: an unrecognized or non-string region (the source silently falls back to global-sg)
a non-preset providerSpecificData.baseUrl (the source sends the key to it)
an identity outside the map (alibaba-cn and other Alibaba-family ids)
regionParity.presetBaseUrl: a saved source chat preset of the same identity (current or retired) is treated as unset, as in the source isFamilyPresetUrl; the region still decides
regionParity.isolation: the origin comes from the adapter's own identity and the selected connection's region only; the key is never sent to another identity's or region's host, redirects are refused, an answer naming another origin is an unknown outcome
regionParity.accounting: success accounting.meta.region records the region served
